question: Can the pinned Gnomix implementation train, serialize, reload and infer reproducibly from the simulated B0 interface before full-panel compute is authorized?

amendment_history.cause: The B0 table used chr22 while the normalized VCF used 22; bcftools correctly returned no records for the mismatched literal contig.
amendment_history.delta: Infer and validate the single REF/TARGET VCF contig, then write that literal contig to the region file. Marker selection and scientific parameters are unchanged.

amendment_history.cause: scikit-learn 1.9.0 removed multiclass liblinear support required by the unchanged Gnomix LogisticRegressionBase.
amendment_history.delta: Pin scikit-learn 1.7.2 in image r4 and require an embedded three-class known-answer audit. Gnomix source, estimator, seed, markers, parameters and resources are unchanged.

software.runtime_compatibility_policy: Gnomix source is unchanged. scikit-learn 1.7.2 is pinned because 1.8+ removed the legacy multiclass liblinear OVR path used by this Gnomix commit. All future B0/BR/BS arms must use this exact image.

source_panel.truth_policy: No truth file or mosaic-event file is an input to this workflow. ASIA must not be relabelled as NAM.

subset.allocation: Reserve one marker in every nonempty bin. Allocate the remaining 9637 markers proportionally to n_bin_minus_1 by largest remainder; sort tied remainders by ascending bin index.
subset.within_bin_selection: For allocation k from n ordered markers, select zero-based indices floor((j+0.5)*n/k) for j=0..k-1.
subset.selection_inputs: B0 marker positions and genetic coordinates only; TARGET genotypes and truth cannot filter or rank markers.
subset.required_parity: Reference and target retain the same 10000 ordered positions and A/C allele encoding.

gnomix_parameters.rationale: Use the historical/default chr22 configuration for compatibility. No hyperparameter screen is permitted in this smoke; the 0.05 cM used by M28B was a matching tolerance, not a Gnomix window.

execution.ordering: Each model must be serialized, audited and hashed before its corresponding TARGET inference process can start.
execution.internal_validation_policy: Gnomix necessarily generates validation metrics from synthetic admixed haplotypes built from the reference split. Preserve these files for audit, but do not inspect or use their values for parameter selection, progression or a thesis claim in this smoke.

gates.T0_AUTH: All input, config, code and container hashes match the frozen contract.
gates.T1_SUBSET: Exactly 10000 ordered markers cover all 363 bins and preserve REF/TARGET phase and marker parity.
gates.T2_BOUNDARY: Training process has no TARGET, truth, mosaic events, BR or BS input.
gates.T3_MODEL: Both replicas train without error and derive C=10000, M=27, W=370, A=3, S=75 and context=13.
gates.T4_SERIALIZATION: Each model pickle is nonempty, hashed and reloads in a separate inference process.
gates.T5_INFERENCE: Both inferences retain 30 target samples, 370 windows, AFR/EUR/ASIA classes, finite probabilities summing to one and no invalid labels.
gates.T6_REPRODUCIBILITY: Replicas have exact MSP labels/metadata and FB probabilities equal within the frozen tolerance.
gates.T7_RESOURCES: Each training stays at or below 6.4 GiB RSS and 24 minutes; exceeding this review threshold blocks automatic progression to full B0.
gates.T8_SCOPE: No TARGET truth, TARGET accuracy, effect, ceiling, BR/BS, NAM or real-DNABR claim is produced. Gnomix internal synthetic-validation artifacts are quarantined and unused for decisions.

stop_rule: Any failed gate stops before full B0. Do not change scientific parameters, add retries, inspect truth, interpret smoke predictions or redimension resources within this preregistration.
